title: Model training method, text classification method, device, computer equipment and medium
assignee: Ping An Technology Shenzhen Co Ltd

pse.problem: Existing text classification models cannot ensure the security of sensitive text data during model training process.
pse.solution_function: The system performs joint learning on encrypted local classification results and model parameters from multiple clients at a federal learning server to obtain updated model parameters for a local text classification model.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of local classification models, data uploading modules, model training modules, and a federal learning server.
pse.solution_implementation: Local classification models are trained on a text training set. Encrypted model parameters and local classification results are uploaded to the federal learning server for joint learning. The server updates the model parameters based on encrypted data from different clients. Updated model parameters are sent back to local classification models.
pse.effect: Improved security of sensitive text data during the model training process
